visual.description: Full-viewport section with a planet image on the right half and text (headline, body, CTA button) anchored to the bottom-left quadrant over a black background.
Full-width image of a rocket on a launch pad with headline and body text centered-right and a CTA button, text overlaid on the image.
Full-width split between two stacked images (aerial launch pad top, rocket landing bottom) with text block (headline, body, CTA) anchored to the bottom-left over the lower image.
Two-column layout where a large astronaut portrait bleeds from the left edge and the headline, body, and CTA occupy the right column on a black background.
Two horizontally-stacked full-width image panels (top: astronaut close-up, bottom: spacecraft interior corridor) with no text overlay.
Two-column layout with headline, body, and CTA on the left and a full-bleed satellite/machinery image filling the right column and background.
Full-width footer with a social icon anchored bottom-left, a centered horizontal nav link row, and a copyright mark anchored bottom-right.
